children: PVR INOX has expanded its Soul Space Spirit property in Bellandur, Bengaluru, with the addition of three new auditoriums, comprising one 4DX screen and two mainstream screens. With this expansion, the cinema now operates a total of seven screens.

The three new auditoriums have been given a dedicated entrance on the fifth floor, while the existing four screens will continue to function from the fourth floor. Across the expanded property, guests will have access to superior laser projection, Dolby Atmos Surround Sound and Next Gen 3D technology. The property's total seating capacity now stands at 1,143.

The newly added auditorium marks Bengaluru's eighth 4DX experience, and is located at Soul Spirit Central Mall, Bellandur, on Outer Ring Road. The cinema has served the Bellandur community for over 15 years, catering to audiences across the Bellandur–Marathahalli–Varthur–Sarjapur Road corridor.

Commenting on the development, Ajay Bijli, Managing Director, PVR INOX Limited, said Bengaluru remains one of India's most dynamic cinema markets, and that the expansion at Soul Space Spirit reflects the company's focus on deepening ties with a community it has served for years while making cinema-going more meaningful and memorable.

Sanjeev Kumar Bijli, Executive Director, PVR INOX Limited, added that the expansion gives audiences greater choice through enhanced technology, contemporary design and a wider range of viewing formats, while helping the property continue to meet evolving expectations of moviegoers.

With this launch, PVR INOX now operates the largest multiplex network in the country, with 1,789 screens across 356 properties in 114 cities in India and Sri Lanka. The company was formed in 2023 through the merger of PVR Limited and INOX Leisure Limited, two of the country's most established cinema brands.

The expansion forms part of PVR INOX's broader strategy of strengthening its footprint in high-growth urban catchments and upgrading established properties in line with changing audience preferences, the company said.
Shares of PVR INOX closed at ₹1,223.20 on the NSE, down 5.77% or ₹66.70, on 8 September 2026.

title: PVR Inox adds three new screens at Bengaluru's Soul Space Spirit, taking tally to 1,789 across India, Sri Lanka
